shared_elements: schematic animal forms with stick-like legs
repetition of small animal figures across the surface
registers or scattered rows of figures
justification: Both surfaces depict schematic quadrupeds and bird-like creatures in profile repeated across a field, which is the main correspondence, but it is a generic one. A shows heavy relief carving with a top register of bucrania-like arched forms above a band of geometry and large, anatomically detailed animals with defined heads and bodies, while B is a flat linear outline drawing of small scattered stick-figure animals, footprint-like signs and abstract linear motifs with no register structure or comparable relationships between figures.
